highlight_title: It is not about selling the exact same template.
highlight_text: The foundation can be shared, but every client gets their own copy, images, services, colors and contact options.
process_title: A simple, transparent process from idea to launch.
process_1_text: We discuss your business, content, required features and preferred design.
process_2_text: I build and present your personalised website based on the quote agreed in advance.
process_3_text: After approval, I configure the website on its final domain and hosting.
about_title: Websites that do not try to be something they are not – they simply present what a business does well.
about_p1: The goal of MesterWeb is simple: create modern, clear and easy-to-use websites that help local businesses build a stronger online presence.
about_p2: The foundation is reusable, so different versions can later be created efficiently for many professions.

sales_title: A good website can be the first impression people get of your business.
sales_text: The MesterWeb foundation is ready to become separate website versions for hairdressers, electricians, auto mechanics, restaurants and other local service providers.

consult_eyebrow: YOU DON'T HAVE TO THINK IN TEMPLATES
consult_title: The website adapts to your business.
consult_text: Your website can be created around your own ideas, with a personalised look and tailored content.
consult_1_text: You do not have to accept a fixed template: the website can be adapted to your business goals and style.
consult_2_text: Your own colours, images, services, texts and contact options can all be built into the website.
consult_3_text: We discuss your needs and ideas, and I help you find the solution that best fits your business.
choice_intro: Not every business needs the same solution. I help you decide whether a focused landing page or a more detailed multi-page website would support your business better.
choice_landing_text: One well-structured page with one clear goal: present the service, build trust and guide the visitor quickly towards a phone call, WhatsApp message or quote request.
choice_landing_best: A good choice for: one main service, a campaign or fast lead generation.
choice_website_text: If you want to present several services, references, a gallery, prices, FAQs and a detailed introduction in an organised way, a multi-page website gives you more room.
choice_website_best: A good choice for: several services, detailed presentation and long-term growth.
choice_social_title: You do not have to choose between them.
choice_social_text: Facebook and Instagram are excellent for attracting attention and showing recent work. Your own website provides an organised, independent place where visitors can easily find services, prices, references and ways to contact you.
choice_note: I do not want to sell you a bigger website than you need – I recommend the solution that genuinely fits your business.
